## Reusable rules

1. **Preserve existing discriminator order when composing unions** Append new union variants after existing preview and GA variants when generated enum ordering is compatibility-sensitive. The initial reviewer identified a shift; the reply described the fix, and the frozen patch places the Microsoft variant after both existing unions. *Scope:* Composed TypeSpec unions whose generated enum ordering is compatibility-sensitive. *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/47330#pullrequestreview-5536968332, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/47330#discussion_r4285953599, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/47330#discussion_r4286777357, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/7d516647501f9a2c594555cd88877753e66d86f5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/tools/models.tsp

2. **Add new preview contracts without repurposing legacy ones** For this compatibility-sensitive preview addition, the patch introduces Microsoft Copilot discriminator/model declarations and an opt-in while retaining the GitHub Copilot contracts and their existing opt-in. This is evidence for an additive migration pattern, not a universal requirement to duplicate APIs. *Scope:* Additive preview discriminator/model migrations where existing private-preview contracts must remain compatible. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/47330, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/7d516647501f9a2c594555cd88877753e66d86f5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/agents/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/7d516647501f9a2c594555cd88877753e66d86f5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/common/servicepatterns.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/7d516647501f9a2c594555cd88877753e66d86f5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/tools/models.tsp
